description: Required save fixture for the headless gameplay cell. The files are user-owned game data and are not committed; the harness copies them from -SavedataSource into its private lab and refuses a lab without slot 1.

files.name: MGS_SystemData
files.role: system save metadata; the title reads it before Continue

files.name: sce_sys/param.sfo
files.role: save-slot metadata; part of the fixture

notes: A lab with only slot 0 (MGS_GameData_0, stage m00_00_80_10) never leaves the menu: there is no Continue target with this progress.
Do not publish or copy these files into Git, a release, or a shared machine profile.
The harness verifies these hashes in meta.save_data for every cell and refuses a mismatch.
